reason: Retain exactly the reviewed 746 lines, 34 methods and 14 fields without growth. This compiler owns one bounded pure syntax-validation and typed-lowering algorithm with shared AST, source spans, allocation pool and admitted arithmetic-index context. It owns no operation authority, I/O dispatch or effect lifecycle. Extracting a forwarding context would obscure admission ordering without separating a domain responsibility. Independent review and the complete 157-test commandsurface package, including complete-unit rejection, mutable versus read-only arithmetic indexes, semantic/scratch boundaries and aggregate-state/snapshot lifetimes, support retaining this cohesive shape. Growth, structural changes or changed boundary contracts require renewed review; these ceilings provide no additional headroom.
